versions.changelog:
Initial release of the douyin-social skill for Douyin content operations and analytics.

- Supports video and text search by keyword with filters for likes, time, duration, and content type.
- Provides real-time Douyin hot search/leaderboard data.
- Fetches public works from a user's homepage via URL or sec_uid.
- Analyzes comments and interaction data from video or note links.
- Command-line driven, no login required, requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for use.
- Designed for workflows such as topic selection, competitor analysis, public opinion monitoring, trend tracking, and content calendar planning.
